notes.title: Garden of the Sea - November Patch [v1.000047]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051942/d3d7a92af79abebc2f1807edfed4a0c5ac8f77a1.png[/img]
Happy Monday gardeners! You might have noticed a patch already having been downloaded for the game! 

It's no dramatic changes but here's what's included:[list]
[*]Added gamepad aim assist
[*]Fixed instrument playing visual effect whilst lowered
[*]Fixed SFX setting navigation
[*]Fixed missing camera sensitivity setting for Xbox and PS gamepads
[*]Fixed dual wielding through dominant hand switching in main menu
[*]Re-implemented dominant hand setting in-game
[*]Increased font sizes in menu book
[*]Fixed missing Asian language glyphs
[/list]

Happy playing! If you haven't already, we'd also love it if you left a review for the game as it helps us a ton with discoverability!  <3

notes.title: Save Directory Fix and Quality of Life Patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051942/f7083a0c24991afb1908f38c615923591c9b468b.png[/img]
[h1]Good afternoon Gardeners! 
[/h1]We’re happy to share with you our first post-release patch for Garden of the Sea! Mainly this patch makes sure that VR and non-VR saves are stored and loaded separately for players who own both versions of the game but we’ve included some neat tweaks as well!
[list]
[*]Save directory fix
[*]Various gameplay improvements and fixes; including but not limited to small changes to item functionality, world collision and other quality of life tweaks
[*]UI fixes for SteamDeck
[/list]
Please let us know if there are any specific issues ailing your experience! The best way to do that is to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/neatcorp]Discord[/url] if you need help or want to talk to us! We’re (mostly😈) nice!

notes.title: We’re re-releasing Garden of the Sea in a non-VR version later this year!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!!

We revealed some super duper exciting news at the Wholesome Direct this weekend: Garden of the Sea is getting a non-VR version!! 

We know some folks have been eyeing our game, which was originally released in 2019, but don’t play in VR, or have wanted to share this game with friends who don’t have VR. We also know that we’ve gotten such a lovely reception on our cozy farming sim that it felt like a waste of an opportunity to not try making it playable for way more people. So behold: later this year, we’re releasing Garden of the Sea, with all of its original features and charms, on Steam! It will have mainstream controller support, and SteamDeck compatibility, so you can just sit back and relax while fishing, watering your plants, or petting the native creatures that live on your island.

We hope you’ve enjoyed a look at our game that’s chock full of fun things to do and relaxing vibes (which we could all certainly use more of during these times)! Please feel free to wishlist it if you like what you see (it helps indies out a lot) and follow us on [url=https://x.com/NeatCorp][u]our[/u][/url] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@neatcorp][u]socials[/u][/url]! 

Talk to you soon!
